title: The future has a past.
scene: OBJECT STILL LIFE, NO living character: a chunky cream vintage CRT computer and keyboard on a wooden desk. The green monochrome monitor shows one tiny simple mole sprite silhouette, a prompt chevron and a few abstract terminal bars (no readable text). A mole-paw-shaped wooden coaster and little potted daisy beside it. Cozy wood study with morning light. CRT dominates 75% of square composition.
motion: Fixed camera, stationary study and computer. The tiny mole sprite on the green screen gently takes two steps in place, terminal cursor blinks, small green power indicator pulses. All movement confined to the screen and light.
prompt: Edit this existing pixel-art scene for a coordinated calendar series.
